HsmmResult codec dependency checkpoint (READ-ONLY; no edits/reservations beyond current candidate) for bd-01M158KA75HGGM118P3SQ1RHYK:

The contextual decoder cannot currently reconstruct the specified wire value from outside align. HsmmResult carries costs: Map[RecallUnitId, Map[AlignState, CostBreakdown]] (hsmm.scala:140-147), and the codec milestone requires sparse costs. CostBreakdown is private[align] (cost.scala:199-206) with only unreachable public; its StructuralMemberEstimate, StructuralMemberExclusion, StructuralReductionReceipt, and StructuralReduction constructors are also private[align] (152-190). AlignmentRow.of / AlignmentMatrix.of are public and flow is constructible, so this is the one hard type boundary.

A second disposition is needed for admissibility: its constructors are intentionally private[align] (525-548), but codec could derive entries contextually with ModeGate.assess(recall unit, view node, view). However HsmmResult equality includes the full admissibility map while the codec milestone's wire list omits it; deriving only anchors observed in posterior/flow/costs/viterbi may not reproduce extra accepted candidate entries.

Recommendation: keep constructors closed and add align-owned validated reconstruction factories for the full cost receipt graph, then have codec decode DTOs and call those factories. Separately decide that admissibility is either (a) encoded then checked against ModeGate, or (b) canonically derived from an explicit candidate-anchor set on the wire; do not silently infer it from sparse appearances if round-trip equality is promised. This dovetails with hsmm.scala:135-138's existing candidate-nomination follow-up. Also keep the already agreed contextual entry point and call HsmmResult.validated; no unconstrained Decoder[HsmmResult].

Requesting chief/M1 disposition before those fields land so codec does not need a package escape hatch or a same-shaped proxy. Current sidecar candidate 3717e7c is unaffected.
